name: django-markdownx
description: Comprehensive Django Markdown editing plugin with live preview, Django Admin integration, drag-and-drop image uploads, and configurable image processing.
agentsOsRelevance: Useful reference for the editing and preview layer around repository-backed Markdown. Especially relevant to Atlas and PLT Content for editor UX, multiple editor instances, media upload flows, and image processing, but not a flat-file persistence or Git-authoritative content solution by itself.
